Ask who is setting the 100.00 price before asking whether it is right. Average trading is 18000000 dollars a day, so the whole market value of 5200000000 turns over in about a year - a thin book for any holder of size. In shares this thin, one motivated buyer can mark the price from 61.00 toward 104.00 without broad participation, and the same thinness works in reverse on the way down.

The record's blind spot here is declared: no short-interest series exists for the name, so crowding cannot be measured. There is no way to know whether the 64 percent rise off the low was accumulation by patient money or a squeeze on a crowded negative bet; the two look identical on a price chart and resolve very differently.

The capture was made on a shut market, so 100.00 is the prior session's last trade, not a live two-sided quote. Anyone acting on this record should expect the first trade to move the price against them in either direction. Structurally: thin tape, unknown crowding, a dated catalyst on 2026-10-20 that will concentrate volume - the price is more fragile than the fundamental arguments assume, in both directions.
